bio.text: Chuck Hubbard, a Democrat from Wilkes County, said in 2025 that he planned to run again in 2026 for North Carolina's 5th Congressional District, held by Rep. Virginia Foxx.

The Yadkin Ripple reported that he began working at the Wilkes Journal-Patriot, a newspaper his grandfather founded in 1932, at age 8, and came to work there full-time after graduating from Wofford College.
The paper quoted him as saying he spent over forty years as a local journalist, and said he lives with his wife Shari.

sources.title: Wilkes County native launches campaign for Congress
